_comment: Unified design tokens for Local Test Servers & Local Report Servers.
Single source of truth located at ai-first-fw/local-theme/theme.json.
Used by portals on ports 23000 & 24000, mock servers on 23001..23200, and report servers on 24001..24002.
_surfaces: darkest to lightest; background canvas, insets, cards, and sub-panels
_text: high contrast primary, secondary, and muted text
_lines: subtle card border line and structure line-2
_status: semantic soft pills matching Dark Report Theme
_categorical: HTTP method badges and category tags
_accents: headers, live dot indicator, and code backgrounds
